## What is The Most Important Thing?

> - The “most important thing” is <span style="color: blue;">**subjective**</span>.
> - <span style="color: blue;">**Primary dimensions**</span>: Health, Love & Relationships, Purpose & Meaning, Gratitude, Freedom, Learning & Growth, Self-Care.
> - This set of dimensions makes a <span style="color: blue;">**conceptual backbone for our capstone**</span>, because it positions the course not as a technical culminating experience, but as a <span style="color: blue;">**professional and personal transition course.**</span>

## The Bridge Between Academic Training and Life (After Graduation)

> - Learn to <span style="color: red;">**go beyond**</span> working your team's project and develop the ability to <span style="color: red;">**work in any project!**</span>
> - Others may always outpace you in coding, surveying, or technical execution.
> - Your true advantage is <span style="color: red;">**systems thinking**</span>, an advantage that reaches its full power only when paired with <span style="color: red;">**strong communication!**</span>

## <span style="color: #800000;">ISEN Mission Statement</span>
**To serve** <span style="color: #C0C0C0;">the state, nation and global community by educating industrial engineering students to be well founded in engineering fundamentals and</span> **to have the knowledge and skills** <span style="color: #C0C0C0;">required</span> <span style="color: green;">**to design, develop, improve, implement and control**</span> <span style="color: #C0C0C0;">sophisticated production and service</span> **systems** <span style="color: #C0C0C0;">in an environment characterized by</span> **complex technical and social challenges**. <span style="color: #C0C0C0;">Throughout this educational process, students will be instilled with the</span> **highest standards of professional and ethical behavior**.
